# MDL902 · `value-template`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A value does not match its template.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | conventions |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

Templates catch a file copied for another database whose `outputdir` or `regex` still points at the first one: two dumps would overwrite each other. The rule does nothing unless the `conventions` section of the configuration sets it up.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
outputdir=/backups/hr
```

```text
2:11-2:22 error MDL902[value-template] mydumper.outputdir is `/backups/hr`, which does not match /sales$
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL902: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL902` on the line above it.
